purpose: Dashboard-only supplement to data/workflows/baseline_study/published_references.json. Values checked against the primary papers' tables online on 2026-10-25 (PDF text via pdftotext for CCN and SNIFFER, arXiv HTML for LAMAR). Published reports, not local results; all non-comparable with this zero-shot study.

entries.citation: Abdelnabi, Hasan, Fritz, Open-Domain, Content-based, Multi-modal Fact-checking of Out-of-Context Images via Online Resources (CCN), CVPR 2022
entries.table_location: arXiv v3 PDF page 6, Table 2: 'Classification performance on the test set for our model in comparison with baselines.' (also Table 1 row 12)
entries.task: binary pristine vs falsified (native NewsCLIPpings task)

results.regime: trained classifier with evidence retrieved from the web (Google Vision inverse image search, Google custom image search)

entries.external_tools_evidence: Web evidence: image-caption pairs used as web-search queries; inverse image search and caption-based image search (paper p.3).

entries.citation: Qi, Yan, Hsu, Lee, SNIFFER: Multimodal Large Language Model for Explainable Out-of-Context Misinformation Detection, CVPR 2024
entries.table_location: PDF page 6, Table 1: 'Performance (%) comparison between SNIFFER and baselines.' (also Table 2 full-model row)
entries.task: binary pristine vs falsified (native NewsCLIPpings task)

results.regime: two-stage instruction tuning on NewsCLIPpings-derived data (71K task samples) plus web-retrieved evidence (reverse image search pages, Google entity detection)

entries.external_tools_evidence: Caption plus text from webpages retrieved via image search, and Google Entity Detection API (paper p.5).
